items.q: The mother of Antonio Maceo, Jose Maceo, and two or three more Maceos, they died for the revolution.

ctx.x: The mother of Antonio Maceo, Jose Maceo, and two or three more Maceos, they died for the revolution. So when the ah - when the United States put the Main in the Habana harbor and blew up and I don't know if it was a accident or was a purpose to declare the war to Spain, because geographically or strategically United States need Cuba for the Panama, Canal de Panama, like Puerto Rico. They was looking for -'for protection. Geographically, Cuba and Puerto Rico was practically the backbone of the defense for the…
Okay, I got the political picture now.
